summary: Ticket topics that stay open. This file is not an analysis input and has no expected findings.

severityScale.meaning: Proposed interface emphasis. Not a medical grade and not a percentage.
severityScale.effect: The other fixtures omit severity. They do not satisfy issue #22 scenario 3.

conflict.proposedMeaning: Two approved rules match the same products and cannot both be followed.
conflict.alternativeToDecide: If conflict only means a stronger caution, severity should carry that strength and conflict should not be a separate outcome.
futureFixtureNeeds: A routine of existing fictional products in which both rules match the same products
A team decision that those rules cannot both be followed
An assigned severity if issue #22 scenario 3 applies
A recorded-allergy input that is not SkinProfile.avoidedIngredients
A confirmed ingredient ID on that allergy
An approved matcher from that ID to confirmed product rows
Agreement that catalog class fragrance-allergen is not itself an allergy rule

layering.preserveOrder: The routine array order is kept on productIDs and is used to sort findings.
layering.doNotEvaluateOrder: No rule in this draft changes a match because of position or returns a recommended sequence.
futureFixtureNeeds: The product facts that rule needs
Agreement that position may be a condition without becoming an ingredient identity
AN-06's recommended-sequence output, which this draft does not define
